title: Rate-on-ingest and exact signature-level rate cache

acceptanceCriteria.description: New synced, webhook, and eligible manual awaiting orders delegate rate-on-ingest admission to the existing durable cache-first rate-backfill owner after authoritative package facts exist.

Warm exact-signature hits include destination, package, residential, confirmation, insurance, and account identity; direct-carrier hits bypass provider quotation while misses fall through to the canonical live owner.
Cached ShipStation and direct-carrier rates remain planning/display truth only and cannot create a purchase-authorizing quote snapshot or selectionRef.

The background owner persists exact signature-cache lookups, full hits, partial hits, misses, provider fetches, and hit-rate percentage without changing durable generation, priority, restart, or fencing behavior.
A deterministic 600-order warm signature benchmark completes in seconds with a measured 100 percent full-hit rate and zero provider fetches.
Rate source-of-truth, cache display, pre-expiry refresh, backend job, selected-rate proof, PS-244, strict TypeScript, and production web build gates pass.

The exact reviewed SHA is live on the existing Render API, sync worker, and print worker and Ready on Vercel, with public health/readiness and all public deployment aliases returning HTTP 200 and zero GitHub Actions runs.

canonicalOwners: src/services/store-order-import.ts and the awaiting-only manual route own post-persistence rate-on-ingest admission
src/services/rates-backfill.ts owns durable cache-first execution, priority, telemetry, and Best Rate persistence
src/services/rates.ts plus src/services/direct-carrier-rate-cache.ts own exact per-account cache reads and provider fallback
src/services/rates-combined.ts owns markup-aware combined Best Rate ranking
src/services/shipping-workflow/rate-quote-snapshot-store.ts owns purchase-authorizing snapshot and selectionRef creation

sotBypass.details: No frontend ranking, cache authority, selected-rate proof, label purchase, or persistence rule was added. Routes admit intent only; backend rate, cache, ranking, and proof owners remain authoritative.

evidence.proves: The runtime-shared cache policy resolves 600 warm signatures as full hits in 0.66 ms in the recorded run, reports a 100 percent hit rate, initiates zero provider fetches, and is wired ahead of direct quoteCarrierRates in the canonical owner.

caveats.description: Two extra non-acceptance checks reproduce unchanged at base SHA 689e3887: PS-271 completeness-honesty has five stale assertions, and the full SOT pack stops at PS-428 when required local Supabase environment values are absent. All PS-459 ticket-named guards pass individually, and the durable PS-436 integration passes with inert offline values.

GET /health/deep returned degraded solely because one pre-existing order-sync account was stale or failed. The exact-SHA deployment itself is healthy: /health and /health/ready are HTTP 200; db, dbWrite, orders, printQueue, printQueueWorker, fulfillmentOutbox, and eventLoop are green; providerPending is zero. PS-459 does not change sync-account freshness ownership.

Vercel marked the exact-SHA Production deployment Ready and Latest but skipped custom-domain assignment; promotion is disabled for this account. The deployment URL, stable-branch alias, and project production alias all return HTTP 200, so the deployment acceptance is satisfied without changing domains or permissions.
